new_defects_found.description: OnceLock HTTP_CLIENT is never re-created if the first build fails (unwrap_or_else fallback to Client::new). A poisoned OnceLock stays poisoned, so transient DNS or TLS config error at first call permanently disables the fallback.
new_defects_found.exploit_or_trigger: Pod reboots during network partition; first HTTP call races with bad resolver config → OnceLock poisoned → fallback silently dead for rest of process life.
new_defects_found.suggested_fix: Replace unwrap_or_else with expect + early return Err so the task retries on next tick instead of poisoning the singleton.

new_defects_found.description: Empty service-key early-return logs at ERROR level but emits no metric/alert. Missing mesh-key file is a deploy mis-configuration that should page operators.
new_defects_found.exploit_or_trigger: Mis-deployed pod missing mesh-key file → fallback skips forever with only one ERROR log line; fleet/health shows stuck_session_candidate but root cause is buried.
new_defects_found.suggested_fix: Emit a counter metric (e.g. session_end_fallback_auth_failures_total) and/or escalate to on-call via existing alert channel.
